subject: English
text: Who wrote the poem 'A Legend of the Northland'?
explanation: 'A Legend of the Northland' is a ballad written by Phoebe Cary.

subject: English
text: In 'Reach for the Top' (Part I), what is the name of the only woman in the world who has scaled Mt. Everest twice?
explanation: Santosh Yadav is the only woman in the world who has climbed Mount Everest twice.

subject: English
text: In 'A House Is Not a Home', what pet did the author love dearly and lose temporarily during the fire?
explanation: The author had a red tabby cat whom he loved dearly and lost when the house caught fire.

subject: English
text: What does the word 'legend' in the context of 'A Legend of the Northland' mean?
explanation: A legend is an old traditional story passed down through generations, which may or may not be historically true.

options.text: An old traditional story passed down

subject: English
text: In 'The Beggar', who is Sergei?
explanation: Sergei is an advocate who offers Lushkoff, the beggar, work to earn money honestly.

options.text: A teacher at the village school

subject: English
text: In 'Reach for the Top' (Part II), which sport is Maria Sharapova associated with?
explanation: Maria Sharapova is a world-renowned professional tennis player from Russia.

subject: English
text: Why did Santosh Yadav leave her home in Haryana at the age of sixteen?
explanation: She was under pressure from her parents to get married, but she wanted to get a proper education first.

options.text: To go on a trekking expedition in the Himalayas
To get a proper education in Delhi instead of marrying
To work as a sports instructor
To visit her grandmother in Rajasthan

subject: English
text: In 'A House Is Not a Home', how did the author's new schoolmates surprise and help him after the fire?
explanation: They collected school supplies, books, and clothes for him, which made him feel accepted and happy.

options.text: They helped him rebuild his house physically
They gathered school supplies, clothes, and books for him
They threw him a birthday party
They gave him a new pet kitten

subject: English
text: In 'A Truly Beautiful Mind', what did Einstein's famous equation E = mc² establish?
explanation: The equation, part of his Special Theory of Relativity, describes the relationship between mass (m) and energy (E).

options.text: The relation between gravitational force and weight
The relationship between mass and energy
The speed of sound in different media

subject: English
text: Identify the direct speech version of: 'He told me that he had already read the book.'
explanation: Past perfect 'had already read' changes to present perfect 'have already read' in direct speech, and 'told me' becomes 'said to me'.

options.text: He said to me, "I have already read the book."
He said to me, "I had already read the book."
He said, "He has already read the book."
He says to me, "I am reading the book."

subject: English
text: What does the poet of 'No Men Are Foreign' want us to remember about all human beings?
explanation: James Kirkup states that no men are strange and no countries are foreign; beneath all uniforms, a single body breathes.

options.text: That we must learn different languages to survive
That we all share the same earth and are essentially brothers
That different countries have superior citizens
That soldiers must defend borders at all costs

subject: English
text: In 'The Beggar', Lushkoff was hired by Sergei to do what job first?
explanation: Lushkoff was first hired by Sergei to chop wood in his yard.

options.text: To chop wood in his yard

subject: English
text: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb: 'Neither of the plans ___ approved by the committee.'
explanation: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb, so 'was' or 'is' is appropriate depending on the tense; here, 'was' is correct.

subject: English
text: In 'My Childhood', what business did Kalam's cousin Samsuddin run in Rameswaram?
explanation: Samsuddin distributed newspapers in Rameswaram, and Kalam helped him catch the newspaper bundles thrown from the moving train.

subject: English
text: Change this sentence to passive voice: 'The students are writing a poem.'
explanation: Present continuous active 'are writing' becomes 'is/are being written' in passive voice.

options.text: A poem was written by the students.
A poem is being written by the students.
A poem has been written by the students.
A poem is written by the students.

subject: English
text: In 'Reach for the Top', what environmental contribution did Santosh Yadav make during her Everest expedition?
explanation: As a member of the Himalayan Environment Trust, she collected and brought down 500 kilograms of garbage from the Himalayas.

options.text: She planted trees at the base camp
She brought down 500 kilograms of garbage from the Everest slopes
She raised funds to protect wild animals in the region

subject: English
text: Identify the correct error correction in the sentence: 'She had left the room before I arrived, so we don't meet.'
explanation: Since both actions happened in the past, 'don't meet' (present tense) should be changed to 'didn't meet' (past tense).

subject: English
text: In the poem 'No Men Are Foreign', what does the poet mean by saying 'their hands are ours, and in their lines we read / A labour not different from our own'?
explanation: He emphasizes that people of other nations work equally hard to earn a living, making their struggles identical to ours.

options.text: That we share similar palm prints and features
That they do the same kind of physical work and hard labor to live
That they use similar tools and machinery
That their boundaries are manually created

subject: English
text: In 'The Last Leaf', what disease was Johnsy suffering from?
explanation: Johnsy was suffering from pneumonia, which was spreading through Greenwich Village in November.

subject: English
text: What did the author of 'A House Is Not a Home' realize when the lady brought back his lost cat?
explanation: The return of the cat helped him overcome his feeling of loss and isolation, making him realize that his life was starting anew.

options.text: He realized that his new school was not worth attending
He realized that his life was coming back to him and he felt gratitude
He realized he needed to buy more fire alarms
He realized the neighbor was looking for a reward

subject: English
text: Complete the sentence with the appropriate modal verb: 'You ___ touch the live wires; it is extremely dangerous.'
explanation: 'Must not' is used to express a strong prohibition, which is appropriate for a highly dangerous situation.

subject: English
text: In the poem 'No Men Are Foreign', what does the poet warn us about when we are told to hate our brothers?
explanation: He warns that by hating others, we disposses, betray, and condemn ourselves, polluting our common air.

options.text: We will lose our land and property to foreigners
We disposses, betray, and condemn ourselves
Our military strength will be reduced

subject: English
text: In 'The Beggar', Lushkoff says, 'By your words and your noble deeds a change took place in my heart.' Who is 'your' referring to in this statement and who actually did the work?
explanation: Lushkoff is speaking to Sergei ('your words'), but he reveals that it was actually Olga's noble deeds and woodchopping that changed him.

options.text: He is speaking to Olga, thanking her for giving him money
He is speaking to Sergei about his words, though Olga did the actual physical work
He is speaking to the notary who gave him a job copy-writing
He is speaking to his mother who guided him in childhood

subject: English
text: Analyze the sentence: 'She behaved in such a manner ___ everyone was shocked.' Which relative/conjunction fits this context?
explanation: The correlative structure is 'such... that' when expressing cause and effect (manner leading to shock).

subject: English
text: In the context of Maria Sharapova's biography 'Reach for the Top', what sacrifice did Maria make at the age of nine that shaped her tennis career?
explanation: She had to leave her mother Yelena behind in Siberia due to visa restrictions and travel alone with her father Yuri to Florida.

options.text: She gave up her high school education entirely
She stayed separated from her mother for two years to train in the US
She changed her Russian citizenship to become American
She worked part-time as a maid to pay for coaching
